params.prompt:
Create one original Age of the Lost full-square skill illustration for Shield Charge. Visual family: physical. Dominant motif: oversized iron shield, leather and momentum marks. Action: Charge toward the cursor, bashing every enemy in your path..
Use the initial AOTL batch as the painted-art framework, especially the rear-view Ember Aura mage and Cinder Thread. A mature illustrated finish, subtle material color, controlled painted light/shadow and crisp clean contours. Navy/brass/iron identity, darker grounded depth and strong school/action recognition. Oversize the actual subject and crop it by multiple square borders; supporting artwork continues through all corners. The entire square is artwork, without a centered emblem on a plain-color background. Include a3–4% beveled dark-metal frame with a near-black outer outline, clear lit/recessed edges and narrow restrained school-tinted inner trim. Keep the painting flush to that inner edge. No labels, letters, keybindings, fake UI, transparent margins, generic vector/3D gloss, coarse brush streaks, gritty/crackle/noise overlay, tiny particle clutter, ambient wisps or scenic landscape. Choose a distinct silhouette and direction that can be identified at32/64px beside the initial skills. Fully opaque PNG, complete1:1 square. This image request does not create or modify gameplay mechanics.

preflight: Use estimate_image_cost first; only submit with the existing unlimited allowance. Never switch to credits.
